# ex: assigneeType for map key-value expression
ex {
	var x int
	x + 0 -> x
}
-- x.go --
package m

var M = map[int]string{
	1 + 0: "one",
	2 + 0: "two",
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 package m

 var M = map[int]string{
-	1 + 0: "one",
-	2 + 0: "two",
+	1: "one",
+	2: "two",
 }
